title: Preserving an indexed entry under concatenation
statement: Let $P$ and $R$ be finite lists of statements, let $p$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a statement. If the entry at index $p$ of $P$ is $b$, then the entry at index $p$ of $P\mathbin{++}R$ is also $b$.
hypotheses_covered: The entry at index $p$ of $P$ is $b$
